english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when something is too painful or unpleasant to put up with.

exampleSentences.english: The heat lately is unbearable for me.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢排咁熱，我真係頂唔順。

english.note: Choose this when the annoyance feels unbearable or you want to stress that you cannot put up with it.

exampleSentences.english: The air conditioner has been broken for a whole week; I'm really fed up with this heat.
